name: AI SEO Content Brief & FAQ JSON-LD Schema Generator

parameters.content:
## AI SEO Content Brief & FAQ JSON-LD Schema Generator

### What this workflow does
Turns any target keyword sent via POST webhook into a complete, developer-ready SEO content brief containing search intent, meta title, meta description, URL slug, H2/H3 outline with talking points, and a ready-to-embed `FAQPage` Schema.org JSON-LD block — returned directly in the webhook HTTP response.

### Setup Steps
1. **Environment Variables:** Set `OPENAI_API_KEY` (required). Optionally set `OPENAI_BASE_URL` and `OPENAI_MODEL` to run with OpenRouter, Groq, or a local Ollama server.
2. **Test the Endpoint:** Send a `POST` request to the webhook URL with `{ "keyword": "n8n workflow automation", "locale": "en-US", "productToPlug": "Your SaaS" }`.
3. **Connect Downstream:** Feed the JSON response directly into Notion, Airtable, WordPress, or your headless CMS.

### 1. Receive & Sanitize Input
Extracts `keyword`, `locale`, and optional `productToPlug` with safe defaults so malformed payloads never break generation.

### 2. Generate Brief, Build FAQPage JSON-LD & Respond
Requests strict JSON output from the LLM, compiles a valid `https://schema.org` `FAQPage` JSON-LD payload, and returns the entire object to the caller.
